content: To guide optimal practices in post-validation activities, the World Health Organization (WHO) has issued a position statement emphasizing the integration of vector management strategies to control malaria and lymphatic filariasis. This document was accessed in January 2017. Additionally, WHO has provided a manual titled Monitoring and Epidemiological Assessment of Mass Drug Administration for Eliminating Lymphatic Filariasis: A Manual for National Elimination Programmes, published in Geneva in 2011. This resource is designed to support national programs in evaluating and monitoring the effectiveness of mass drug administration efforts. Furthermore, WHO has developed an aide-mémoire titled Lymphatic Filariasis: Managing Morbidity and Preventing Disability, which serves as a practical guide for national program managers. This document, also accessed in January 2017, focuses on strategies to address morbidity and prevent disability associated with lymphatic filariasis.
